Subject: OEM quote and leadtime options for DL-2026-ATL-87

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the call earlier — attaching the updated OEM quote (Nebula_OEM_Quote_v2.pdf). Summary of options we can support for the AtlasAI order: 

1) Standard fulfillment (50 units) — 12–14 week lead time from PO.
2) Staged shipments (25 / 25) — first shipment in 8–9 weeks, remainder in 13 weeks. Additional handling fee applies.
3) Expedited slot (priority machining + dedicated line) — 6–7 weeks but requires 30% deposit and minimal order of 40 units.

Notes: the expedited lane availability is limited for July/August; if you need a firm ship window we need a PO or deposit to hold the slot.

I also copied Strata (cloud-sales) — they can hold cloud reserved capacity (regional pool) for ~60 days with a soft-commit, but that requires a linked purchase agreement so they can carve the pool.

Happy to walk through numbers with the commercial team — let me know a time.

Best,
Tara Nguyen
Head of Sales, Nebula Compute

Thanks Tara — solid options. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- AtlasAI deal target ship windows: they need first capacity by early September (target 2026-09-06) to hit their public beta. Full fleet can land later in Q4.
- We prefer staged shipments (option 2) but would consider expedited for the first tranche if we can minimize deposit exposure. Can you confirm whether the staged first shipment (8–9 weeks) can be guaranteed to a calendar week rather than a rolling window?
- For Strata: we need a reserve hold for 120TB pool (gpus in us-west-2) from 2026-09-01 for 90 days. What documentation do you need to do a soft hold?

Internal notes: Ben/Marissa — if we can get a firm week for the first 25 units, we should align an interim bridge in our Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) so AtlasAI doesn't suffer a downtime window. Jonas/Dev — I need a quick estimate of the cost delta for renting short-term burst capacity (2–4 week overlap) in case the staged first delivery slips by 1–2 weeks.

I'll consolidate and reply to Tara with one ask: firm week for first shipment + Strata hold steps.

Thanks,
Ava Chen

- Risk: if the first tranche slips beyond 4 weeks from target, AtlasAI's integration plan will become constrained and we should discuss a temporary SL adjustment.
